steps.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(1)(A): exclude the trigger date {trigger}

court days: advance {n} business day(s) {forward} from {trigger} (skipping weekends/holidays) -> {date}

backward.text: Fed. R. App. P. 26(a)(5): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}
